R-hierarchy.reason: The $1,284.50 monthly spend hero card and primary Add expense control lead clearly above the 4-category breakdown and recent transactions across all views.

R-fill.reason: Only the hero budget card (primaryContainer) and the primary Add expense control (primary) use strong green fills while category tiles, pace card, and transaction rows stay on neutral surface containers.

R-surfaces.reason: Tonal surface steps (surface backdrop, surfaceContainerLow cards, surfaceContainerHigh segmented rows, and primaryContainer hero) establish clear grouping and separation in every render.

R-controls.reason: Every interactive element (Add expense button/FAB, category tiles, FilterChip bar, SegmentedListItem rows, and navigation items) reads as an individual tappable control.

R-font.reason: Bold Fraunces gives a clear editorial voice to the Pocket title and hero monetary figures ($1,284.50, $51.38/day, -$148.50), paired with Google Sans Flex labels and Google Sans Code tabular numbers.

R-platform.reason: The app uses Android edge-to-edge layout, Material top bar without Cancel/Done text, and transaction rows without iOS disclosure chevrons.

R-text.reason: All text fits cleanly without clipping, unintended truncation, or overlap across light, dark, foldable, tablet, and desktop renders.

R-dark.reason: In home-dark.png, all titles, tabular amounts, category icons, filter chips, and bottom navigation items remain crisp and legible against dark surfaces.

R-adaptive.reason: The layout adapts from a single-column phone layout with bottom bar to a collapsed rail and 4-column categories on foldable, a 2-pane layout with Monthly pace and activity list on tablet, and an expanded rail with a 3rd transaction detail pane on desktop.

R-idea.reason: The Warm Editorial Ledger combines serif Fraunces currency headlines, monospaced tabular figures, an expressive wavy budget progress bar, and distinct MaterialShapes category badges.

R-semantics.reason: SectionTitle and the Add expense form header apply Modifier.semantics { heading() }, ExpenseRow uses SegmentedListItem's selected overload, and FilterChips are single controls with no split row/widget callbacks.

R-fields.reason: Both OutlinedTextField inputs in AddExpenseForm use state = rememberTextFieldState() rather than value/onValueChange overloads.

R-visibility.reason: Conditional UI (tabs, Show all button, Add expense sheet/dialog, and desktop detail pane) uses if branches so hidden content leaves composition rather than fading to zero alpha.

R-blur.reason: No Modifier.blur is used anywhere in the proposal source.

R-finance-categories.reason: Fun uses neutral surfaceContainerHighest for both its badge and its LinearProgressIndicator color on a surfaceContainerHighest track, making its 13% progress segment invisible against the track and lacking a distinct hue alongside Transport's muted secondaryContainer green.
